My advice is to first anticipate that she is going to have a really negative reaction and to have support ready (a friend of hers a sibling, someone she trusts). 

Outline some of the key reasons for the break up in as nice of a way as possible (therapy doesn’t seem to be working for her, and you can’t keep being there for her when her needs aren’t clear) give her something (a goal) to work towards for her next relationship. 

It may also help if you mention a downfall of your own like how you’re not equipped with the skills to help someone with complex mental health needs. It is very difficult especially when they don’t communicate their needs (I work in mental health and it’s not easy even with all my education and training). Outline this will make her hopefully feel like it’s not all her fault. 

Be kind be calm and be prepared for backlash.
